doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on valid POST /players/ with a Location header. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a fully-populated valid payload not in the DB returns 201 + Location; (2) EP positive — minimal required fields only (optional fields omitted) returns 201; (3) NEG — duplicate squad_number returns 409; (4) NEG — missing required field 'first_name' returns 422; (5) NEG — missing required field 'last_name' returns 422; (6) NEG — missing required field 'squad_number' returns 422; (7) NEG — missing required field 'position' returns 422; (8) BVA — squad_number boundary (new squad 27, one above max seeded) returns 201; (9) DT — payload with all optional fields null/omitted returns 201 and response body contains correct fields; (10) STC — create then attempt duplicate triggers 409 (state transition from non-existent to existing). Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully-populated valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Lionel', lastName='Messi', squadNumber=99, position='Forward'
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall respond HTTP 201 on valid POST /players/
R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Forward",
        "abbrPosition": "FW",
        "team": "Inter Miami",
        "league": "MLS",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Lionel"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Messi"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Forward"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["middleName"] == "Andres"
    assert body["starting11"] is True

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_create_then_duplicate_returns_409
preconditions: Squad number 88 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=88 (first call — player does not exist)
POST /players/ with squad_number=88 again (second call — player now exists)
expected: First POST returns HTTP 201 Created with Location '/players/squadnumber/88'
trace: R-PLAYER-006: HTTP 201 on valid creation
R-PLAYER-006: HTTP 4xx on client error (duplicate)
STC: state transitions from non-existent -> created -> conflict
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_create_then_duplicate_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Carlos",
        "lastName": "Tevez",
        "squadNumber": 88,
        "position": "Centre-Forward",
        "team": "Boca Juniors"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r1.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/88"
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1["squadNumber"] == 88
    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert "detail" in body2

tests.name: test_post_player_response_body_contains_uuid_id_field
preconditions: Squad number 55 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with valid payload and squad_number=55
Inspect response body for 'id' field as a valid UUID string
expected: Response body 'id' field is a non-empty string parseable as UUID
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201
PlayerResponseModel: id field (UUID) must be present in response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from uuid import UUID
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_response_body_contains_uuid_id_field():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Ronaldo",
        "lastName": "Nazario",
        "squadNumber": 55,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None
    parsed = UUID(str(body["id"]))
    assert str(parsed) == body["id"]
    assert body["firstName"] == "Ronaldo"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Nazario"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 55
